What we do

01

Weddings & celebrations

A fully stocked mobile bar tailored to your most important day. From cocktail hour to last orders, we handle everything — set up, service and clean up — so you can be present for every moment.

02

Private parties

Birthday, anniversary, garden party, milestone — whatever the occasion, we bring the atmosphere. Bespoke cocktail menus, signature serves and the energy to match your celebration.

03

Corporate events

Impress clients and energise your team. We work seamlessly alongside your event, with branded packages available for product launches, summer parties and company dinners.

About ORPI

More than
just a bar.

ORPI Events was born in July 2025 with a simple belief: that a great bar doesn't just serve drinks — it sets the tone for the whole event. We bring the cocktails, the energy, the professionalism, and the vibes your guests will be talking about long after the night ends.

Whether it's a 30-person garden party or a 200-guest wedding reception, we show up fully prepared, take ownership, and make the bar one of the highlights of your day.

How it works

01

Get in touch

Tell us about your event — date, location, rough guest count and what you have in mind. No detail is too small.

02

Build your package

We craft a bespoke drinks menu and package around your style, theme and budget. We can even arrange a tasting.

03

Confirm & relax

Secure your date with a deposit. From here, we handle everything — logistics, sourcing, setup — you don't lift a finger.

04

We show up & deliver

We arrive, set up, serve all night and clean up after. You enjoy every moment — that's the ORPI promise.
